variantMap.trigger: 60 variants = 3 Size × 8 Status × 2 Range × Disable=false, plus Disable=true × 2 Status (default/filled) × 3 Size × 2 Range
variantMap.dateItem: 28 authored variants; not a full Cartesian product
variantMap.monthItem: Default / Hover / Selected / Disabled（Hover 于 2026-09-10 由设计补充，节点 4812:21021，复用 .gj-calendar-cell 的 --ds-background-hover）

assetMap.calendar: assets/icons/general/system/icon-calendar.svg or its compiled System iconfont glyph
assetMap.colorRule: All icon color follows the surrounding text/control via currentColor.

interactionMap.default: Trigger opens the popup and moves focus into the calendar.
interactionMap.focusOpen: .gj-date-trigger:focus-visible, [aria-expanded=true], .is-focus → Border/focused 1.5px + 4px #2B73FF40 shadow. Open is not a Figma Status.
interactionMap.clear: Not a trigger Status; panel footer Clear only.
interactionMap.disabled: Disabled has highest precedence and suppresses hover/press/select feedback; do not implement Figma's disabled+hover background.
interactionMap.range: First selection starts the range; second completes it; reverse endpoints when needed.
interactionMap.keyboard: Arrow keys move the active day; Enter/Space selects; Escape closes and restores trigger focus.

accessibility.trigger: Expose accessible name, value, expanded state and popup relation.
accessibility.grid: Use grid/gridcell semantics or an equivalent documented pattern with one roving tab stop.
accessibility.selected: Expose aria-selected; do not rely on color alone.
